_readme: One catalogue of truth for LUKE's online surfaces. ONLY providers that cost
nothing and need no payment card are registered here. Everything that was
paid, prepaid, subscription, card-backed trial credit, or hardware/infra
was removed outright at the owner's request; there is no switch to bring
them back, so a paid endpoint cannot be reached even with a saved key.
Any provider missing from this catalogue fails closed (free=false).
- verifiedAt is a visible date, not a promise; free tiers rotate, so
use List models / Test in Settings before relying on an id.
transport: true means LUKE can actually call it today. false means it is
documented as a free option but needs an adapter (never silently attempted).

providers.label: Free Claude Code (this machine)
providers.note: Keyless loopback proxy. LUKE enforces free-only on its own catalogue; FCC's own MODEL/Providers config decides what it spends.

providers.label: NVIDIA NIM
providers.note: Free OpenAI-compatible endpoints. Model ids rotate and hosted models carry end-of-life dates; use List models.

providers.label: Google Gemini API
providers.rateLimit: per-project caps shown in AI Studio
providers.note: Best free multimodal input. Uses the OpenAI-compatible /v1beta/openai endpoint. Free-tier prompts may be used to improve Google products outside the EEA/UK/CH.

providers.label: Mistral AI (Free mode)
providers.rateLimit: usage caps shown in the Admin Panel Limits page
providers.note: Free mode without a card. Exact allowance and which models carry vision are shown in the account, so probe before relying on them.

providers.label: OpenRouter :free
providers.rateLimit: about 20 requests/minute and 50 requests/day until $10 of credits, then 1,000/day
providers.note: Only ids ending in :free are free. The whole free roster rotated between June and September 2026; List models is mandatory.

providers.label: Z.ai (GLM Flash)
providers.note: GLM-4.7-Flash is priced at zero per token; the Flash suffix no longer guarantees a zero price.

providers.label: Cloudflare Workers AI
providers.note: Uses its own /ai/run URL rather than OpenAI chat completions; needs a dedicated adapter before it can join the chain.

providers.label: Venice AI (free uncensored)
providers.note: Hosted open-weight models with no extra policy layer; illegal content is still blocked. A separate :free Venice model is also reachable through OpenRouter. Needs its own adapter.

providers.label: Meta AI (Llama open weights)
providers.note: No direct free Meta API; Llama reaches LUKE for free as a local GGUF or through Groq/NVIDIA/OpenRouter/Cloudflare.

providers.label: Local GGUF (LUKE, this machine)
providers.note: The last link of every chain and the only tier with no provider-side policy. An abliterated / Dolphin / Hermes checkpoint gives the 'no filter' lane; weights stay on this machine.

providers.label: Groq (LPU)
providers.rateLimit: published free plan ~30 RPM / 1,000 RPD on gpt-oss models
providers.note: Free plan for open models (2026 sources disagree with an older per-token note). LUKE never auto-enables it: connect a key only after checking the live rate-limit page. A 402 is classified now_paid, recorded as blocked, and falls through to the next free link or the local GGUF model.

providers.label: Cohere (trial key)
providers.rateLimit: about 20 RPM / 1,000 calls per month, non-commercial trial
providers.note: Non-commercial trial key with a bounded monthly call count. Free to use until the grant is spent; the owner binds the key on the provider site.

providers.label: Microsoft Azure AI / Azure OpenAI
providers.rateLimit: $100 student credit or startup grants, card for the general trial
providers.note: $100 student credit / startup grants, card bound on the provider site. Free to use until the grant is spent; LUKE never sees card data and never tops up.

providers.label: AWS Bedrock / SageMaker / Trainium
providers.note: New-account credits / Activate grants, card bound on the provider site. Free to use until the grant is spent; never a paid upgrade.

providers.label: Google Cloud Vertex AI / TPUs
providers.note: $300 cloud trial, card bound on the provider site. Veo video generation lives behind this credit and is usable until the grant is spent.

providers.label: Cerebras
providers.note: $5 / 30-day trial, card bound on the provider site (the old 1M tokens/day tier became this trial in July 2026). Usable until spent.

providers.label: SambaNova Cloud
providers.rateLimit: stopped granting credits to new accounts in 2026
providers.note: Only usable if the owner already holds a grant: new-account credits stopped in 2026. No new credit is assumed.

providers.label: Hugging Face Inference Providers
providers.rateLimit: sources conflict: $0.10/month, no credits, or $2/month on PRO
providers.note: Inference Providers credit; 2026 reports conflict on the exact amount. Probe the live account before relying on it; never assume a recurring tier.

policy.meaning: เสียตังค์ = ต้องจ่ายตังค์มาใช้ต่อ (having to pay to keep using). Free tiers and card-backed trial grants are usable free usage.
policy.rule: Use every registered free allowance fully. When a grant or quota is exhausted, or an upstream answers 402 / quota / billing, LUKE refuses to pay: it moves to the next free link and finally to the local GGUF / local media engines.
never: a switch that allows paid providers
